items.text: Patriots officially placed WR A.J. Brown on injured reserve (high ankle sprain); minimum 4 weeks. Signed DT DaQuan Jones in related move.
items.why: MRI confirmed high ankle; sidelined at least 4 games per sources.
items.implication: NE WR corps thinned long-term; dig for depth/waivers.
items.opportunity: Increased targets to remaining NE pass-catchers.

items.text: Falcons QB Cooper Rush experienced back spasms Saturday but team says he still will start Sunday at PIT (replacing OUT Tua/Penix).
items.why: Tua oblique OUT, Penix inactive; Rush spasms but cleared to start.
items.implication: Lower pass efficiency/volume expectations but still start skill players.
items.opportunity: Bijan still lead back; London/Pitts viable but tempered ceilings.

items.text: Brock Bowers listed OUT for Sunday after meniscus trim procedure; expected 1-2 weeks. Raiders TE usage shifts heavily.
items.why: Meniscus trim this week; confirmed on ETR Sunday injury report and Schefter OUT list.
items.implication: Major TE downgrade; stream/pivot needed Week 1-2.
items.opportunity: Full TE target share available in LV offense.

items.text: Ashton Jeanty listed IN after full practices; off injury report and good to go vs MIA despite prior ankle scare that tanked ADP.
items.why: Full participant all week; Schefter confirmed off report and good to go.
items.implication: RB1 workload expected as focal point with Bowers out; possible slight ease-in but high volume.
items.opportunity: Three-down workhorse role vs soft MIA run D; primary LV offensive engine.

items.text: Malik Nabers QUESTIONABLE (knee); practiced fully but hedged comments. Giants elevated Braxton Berrios and signed Dalen Cambre.
items.why: Knee recovery from prior ACL; full practices but coach/player non-committal; Rapoport elevations signal contingency.
items.implication: Game-time risk for SNF; have backup ready. If out, major WR vacuum.
items.opportunity: If active, full WR1 role; if OUT, targets to secondary WRs.

items.text: Christian McCaffrey is a BUY LOW. Contrarian take: don't freak over preseason usage or Kaelon Black looks; banged up preseason + long flight + weird game explain it.
items.why: Preseason limitations and travel/game context; expects bounce.
items.implication: Hold/start with confidence; trade market may undervalue.
items.opportunity: Full CMC role expected going forward despite early optics.
items.conflict: Conflicts with some usage panic narratives.

items.text: Sean Tucker (hamstring) DOUBTFUL/absence gives sneaky goal-line boost to Bucky Irving and Kenny Gainwell. Levitan flags as key implication from ETR report.
items.why: Hamstring; limited practices, coach doubtful designation. Tucker was GL vulture.
items.implication: Irving/Gainwell gain TD upside and early-down/GL shares vs CIN.
items.opportunity: Goal-line and short-yardage carries/snaps expand for both.

items.text: Alvin Kamara (knee) QUESTIONABLE; status a bit impactful for Travis Etienne projection. Kamara returned but limited role expected behind Etienne deal.
items.why: Knee; full practice Friday but Q tag. Etienne signed big deal as lead.
items.implication: If Kamara limited/out, Etienne volume rises; if in, split work with Kamara change-of-pace.
items.opportunity: Etienne lead RB snaps/carries/routes if Kamara sits or restricted.

items.text: Most ADP-tanked August injury guys are go for W1: Jeanty, Jeremiyah Love, Egbuka, Alec Pierce, Keaton Mitchell, Jakobi Meyers etc. Some docks for recent returnees who missed camp.
items.why: Full practices and ETR IN list; Love still Q/GTD but others clear.
items.implication: Value bounce-back for previously discounted players; check projections for docks.

items.text: Ja'Marr Chase listed IN; cleared after late-camp knee scare that looked severe initially.
items.why: Practiced and expected to play per ETR and reports; Higgins also trending up.
items.implication: WR1 locked in with Burrow; no dock needed.
items.opportunity: Full routes/targets in high-powered CIN offense vs TB.

items.text: Emeka Egbuka listed IN after full practices; cleared toe injury that limited preseason.
items.why: Full-go per coach; off report/ETR IN list. ADP had tanked.
items.implication: TB WR opportunity expands especially with McMillan doubtful.
items.opportunity: Increased routes/snaps in Bucs passing game.

items.text: Tua OUT / Rush starting not ideal but not train wreck. Lower expectations for Bijan/London/Pitts but still obviously starting all; Rush competent/serviceable.
items.why: Rush experienced backup; offense still functional enough for studs.
items.implication: No sits; mild downgrade in projections only.
items.opportunity: Bijan volume safe; London/Pitts still primary targets.

items.text: Chuba Hubbard is a flex play this week but viable; 'keeping it open' on The Chubbler amid Brooks groin notes.
items.why: Brooks lingering issues open door; Hubbard healthy full practices.
items.implication: Viable flex with upside if Brooks limited.
items.opportunity: Lead or committee carries/routes vs CHI.

items.text: Saquon Barkley makes the Love List for Week 1 (pains Berry as Commanders fan).
items.why: Strong matchup/role expected in PHI offense.
items.implication: Strong start candidate; prioritize in lineups.
items.opportunity: High carry/target share and RZ work.
